claims.claim_text: Rigetti has multi-year development contracts with DARPA (Quantum Benchmarking Phase 2, awarded Nov 2023) to develop benchmarks for quantum application performance on large-scale quantum computers.
claims.subject: Rigetti Computing
claims.source_quote: In November 2023, we were awarded Phase 2 of the DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Program to develop benchmarks for quantum application performance on large-scale quantum computers... Rigetti was awarded Phase 1 in March 2022.

claims.claim_text: Rigetti was awarded a DARPA project under the IMPAQT (Imagining Practical Applications for a Quantum Tomorrow) program in September 2023, called SPEEQ, to advance quantum algorithms for combinatorial optimization.
claims.subject: Rigetti Computing
claims.source_quote: In September 2023, we were awarded a DARPA project as part of the Imagining Practical Applications for a Quantum Tomorrow (IMPAQT) program... Our project, Scheduling Problems with Efficient Encoding of Qubits (SPEEQ)...

claims.claim_text: Rigetti has a partnership with NASA and DARPA for secure dynamic message scheduling using high-demand space and national security assets.
claims.subject: Rigetti Computing

claims.claim_text: Rigetti UK was awarded a Small Business Research Initiative grant funded by Innovate UK (Feb 2024) to develop and deliver a 24-qubit quantum computer to the National Quantum Computing Centre (NQCC).
claims.subject: Rigetti UK Limited
claims.source_quote: in February 2024, Rigetti UK Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of our Company, announced that it was awarded a Small Business Research Initiative grant funded by Innovate UK to develop and deliver a 24-qubit quantum computer to the National Quantum Computing Centre.

claims.claim_text: Rigetti maintains a portfolio of 84 issued and 106 pending patents protecting its quantum computing IP.

claims.claim_text: Rigetti owns and operates Fab-1, a 53,800 sq ft dedicated wafer fabrication facility in Fremont, California for quantum processor prototyping and production.
claims.subject: Rigetti Computing
claims.source_quote: Our Fab-1 facility is located in Fremont, California, where the company leases approximately 53,800 square feet pursuant to a lease that expires September 30, 2029.
